title: MultiplayerSpawner produces "get_cached_object: ID # not found in cache of peer 1." when connected with a second client.
body:
### EDIT + Solution:

Closing this issue because the problem was because SetMultiplayerAuthority was setting the authority recursive and also for the synchronizer that was controlling the visibility. When only setting the authority on the parent object for the client but leaving the authority of the Synchronizer on the server the behaviour was as expected and the server was still able to control the visibility for the spawned object.


### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.3.stable.mono.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Windows 11 64 Bit - Godot 4.3 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10900K CPU @ 3.70GHz - 32.0 GB RAM - Asus GTX 4080 SUPER

### Issue description

I am using a headless server as well as two clients that are connected to the server.

Using a MultiplayerSpawner with a custom spawn function that spawns inside a nested Object that is also spawned by a MSpawner.

On the server as well as the first client everything runs fine and both show the structure which they supposed to, but failing so in the second connected client. Especially when assigning a MultiplayerAuthority inside the custom spawn function and leaving its Public Visibility on its Synchronizer to true (See Bonus below).

Note:
The attached MRP is a rip-off of my current game architecture, it will create a PlayerIdentity.json file with a GUID stored in the user:// folder to be able to recognize clients in a later process... The server will receive that information when connecting via client and using PlayerIdentifier.cs to check if the user is known or not. Upon recognition it will load the data that belongs to the user. I left that in because I want to show the problem as near as possible to my architecture. The code flow is the same as in my main Project and it will produce the same errors when following the steps below for the MRP.

## Expected Behaviour
All clients should sync the spawned nodes without errors

## Point of interests:

res://worlds/WorldManager/WorldManager.cs
Line 85- 89
When executed in this order will throw error on second client only
When switched will throw error as soon as the first client connects

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b67c4af-7e14-4de6-9d44-7d84dc19bd0a)


res://worlds/WorldManager/WorldManager.cs
Line 91- 98
When uncommenting those lines, then this will prevent errors when Public Visibility is turned off in ShipContainer.tscn/MultiplayerSynchronizer AND when SetMultiplayerAuthority is out-commented in PlayerShipSpawner.cs on line 92
